verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of a self-service transaction/card limit increase request feature; closest is general card creation speed (ramp-comm-2) which does not address limit increases. Since Ramp is a card/spend platform, this axis clearly applies, but no evidence supports it — missing for 10: any documentation or community mention of a limit-increase request flow, approval workflow, or self-service screen for adjusting card limits.
